## History

Small Anne Cordelia was known to the world of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for two happy years. She was held by her mother, [Diana](../character/diana.md), in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret while [Diana](../character/diana.md) chatted with [Anne](../character/anne.md) about Anne's upcoming marriage to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She later attended [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Gilbert's wedding celebration in the orchard, where loved ones gathered before the newlyweds departed for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P9](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P15](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), +17 more_
